en: A commemorative postal card featuring a detailed black‑and‑white portrait of a man in profile on the left, identified as Paul Keres with his lifespan dates 1916–1975. On the right is a pre-printed Estonian postage stamp showing a chess piece (a king) and additional text honoring Paul Keres, with a circular postmark and a crown motif. A blue 'Prioritaire Par Avion' airmail label appears above the address lines on the right. The lower right corner bears the Eesti Post logo.
